items.text: I deeply enjoy this game, however, I cannot recommend it at this point because it is clearly not ready for 1.0 release. I don't understand why great early access games do this. It is still buggy, interpersonal interactions are still quite unpredictable, it needs more time in the oven. Buy it and play it, but don't expect it to play like a complete game yet.
items.text_zh: 我非常喜欢这款游戏，然而，在目前这个阶段我无法推荐它，因为它显然还没有准备好发布1.0版本。我不明白为什么优秀的抢先体验游戏要这样做。它仍然有很多漏洞，人际互动仍然相当不可预测，它还需要更多时间打磨。买它、玩它，但别指望它现在就能像一款完整的游戏那样运行。
